morning.text:
أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ.
morning.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwa, Al-Hayyul-Qayyum...
morning.translation: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence...

morning.text:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۞ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۞ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۞ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
morning.transliteration: Qul huwallahu ahad...
morning.translation: Say: 'He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge...'

morning.text:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۞ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۞ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۞ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۞ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
morning.transliteration: Qul a'udhu birabbil-falaq...
morning.translation: Say: 'I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, From the evil of that which He created...'

morning.text:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۞ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۞ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۞ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۞ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۞ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
morning.transliteration: Qul a'udhu birabbin-nas...
morning.translation: Say: 'I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind...'

morning.text: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ، وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ.
morning.transliteration: Asbahna wa-asbahal-mulku lillah...
morning.translation: We have reached the morning and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty...

morning.text: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ.
morning.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsayna...
morning.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening...

morning.text: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
morning.transliteration: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa ant...
morning.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is none worthy of worship but You...

morning.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي.
morning.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah...
morning.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this life and the next...

morning.text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ.
morning.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'as-mihi shai'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i...
morning.translation: In the Name of Allah with Whose Name there is protection against every kind of harm...

morning.text: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا.
morning.transliteration: Raditu billahi Rabban, wa bil-Islami dinan...
morning.translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion...

morning.text: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ.
morning.transliteration: Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum, birahmatika astaghith...
morning.translation: O Ever-Living One, O Eternally Self-Sustaining One, by Your Mercy I call on You...

morning.text: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ.
morning.transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa Huwa 'alayhi tawakkaltu...
morning.translation: Allah is sufficient for me. There is none worthy of worship but Him...

morning.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ.
morning.transliteration: Allahumma inni asbahtu ush'hiduka wa ush'hidu hamalata 'arshika...
morning.translation: O Allah, I have entered the morning, and I call upon You, the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels, and all of Your creation to bear witness that You are Allah...

morning.text: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ.
morning.transliteration: Allahumma ma asbaha bi min ni'matin aw bi-ahadin min khalqika...
morning.translation: O Allah, whatever blessing I or any of Your creation has risen upon, is from You alone, without partner...

morning.text: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
morning.transliteration: Allahumma 'afini fi badani, Allahumma 'afini fi sam'i, Allahumma 'afini fi basari...
morning.translation: O Allah, grant me well-being in my body. O Allah, grant me well-being in my hearing. O Allah, grant me well-being in my sight...

morning.text: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ.
morning.transliteration: Allahumma 'Alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadati, Fatiras-samawati wal-ard...
morning.translation: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the earth...

morning.text: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ.
morning.transliteration: Asbahna 'ala fitratil-Islam, wa 'ala kalimatil-ikhlas...
morning.translation: We rise upon the fitrah of Islam, and the word of sincerity, and upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad...

morning.text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ.
morning.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih.
morning.translation: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him.

morning.text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
morning.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd...
morning.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise...

morning.text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ: عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ.
morning.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi: 'adada khalqihi, wa rida nafsihi, wa zinata 'arshihi, wa midada kalimatihi.
morning.translation: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him, by the number of His creation, by His pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the extent of His words.

morning.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا.
morning.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan.
morning.translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.

morning.text: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ.
morning.transliteration: Astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh.
morning.translation: I seek the forgiveness of Allah and repent to Him.

evening.text:
أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ.
evening.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwa, Al-Hayyul-Qayyum...
evening.translation: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence...

evening.text:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۞ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۞ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۞ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
evening.transliteration: Qul huwallahu ahad...
evening.translation: Say: 'He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge...'

evening.text:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۞ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۞ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۞ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۞ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
evening.transliteration: Qul a'udhu birabbil-falaq...
evening.translation: Say: 'I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, From the evil of that which He created...'

evening.text:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۞ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۞ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۞ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۞ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۞ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
evening.transliteration: Qul a'udhu birabbin-nas...
evening.translation: Say: 'I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind...'

evening.text: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ، وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ.
evening.transliteration: Amsayna wa-amsal-mulku lillah...
evening.translation: We have reached the evening and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty...

evening.text: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ.
evening.transliteration: Allahumma bika amsayna wa bika asbahna...
evening.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the evening and by You we enter the morning...

evening.text: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
evening.transliteration: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa ant...
evening.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is none worthy of worship but You...

evening.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي.
evening.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah...
evening.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this life and the next...

evening.text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ.
evening.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'as-mihi shai'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i...
evening.translation: In the Name of Allah with Whose Name there is protection against every kind of harm...

evening.text: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا.
evening.transliteration: Raditu billahi Rabban, wa bil-Islami dinan...
evening.translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion...

evening.text: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ.
evening.transliteration: Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum, birahmatika astaghith...
evening.translation: O Ever-Living One, O Eternally Self-Sustaining One, by Your Mercy I call on You...

evening.text: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ.
evening.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
evening.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

evening.text: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ.
evening.transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa Huwa 'alayhi tawakkaltu...
evening.translation: Allah is sufficient for me. There is none worthy of worship but Him...

evening.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَمْسَيْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ.
evening.transliteration: Allahumma inni amsaytu ush'hiduka wa ush'hidu hamalata 'arshika...
evening.translation: O Allah, I have entered the evening, and I call upon You, the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels, and all of Your creation to bear witness that You are Allah...

evening.text: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَمْسَى بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ.
evening.transliteration: Allahumma ma amsa bi min ni'matin aw bi-ahadin min khalqika...
evening.translation: O Allah, whatever blessing I or any of Your creation has come upon this evening, is from You alone, without partner...

evening.text: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
evening.transliteration: Allahumma 'afini fi badani, Allahumma 'afini fi sam'i, Allahumma 'afini fi basari...
evening.translation: O Allah, grant me well-being in my body. O Allah, grant me well-being in my hearing. O Allah, grant me well-being in my sight...

evening.text: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ.
evening.transliteration: Allahumma 'Alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadati, Fatiras-samawati wal-ard...
evening.translation: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the earth...

evening.text: أَمْسَيْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ.
evening.transliteration: Amsayna 'ala fitratil-Islam, wa 'ala kalimatil-ikhlas...
evening.translation: We have entered the evening upon the fitrah of Islam, and the word of sincerity, and upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad...

evening.text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ.
evening.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih.
evening.translation: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him.

evening.text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
evening.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd...
evening.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner...

evening.text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ: عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ.
evening.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi: 'adada khalqihi, wa rida nafsihi, wa zinata 'arshihi, wa midada kalimatihi.
evening.translation: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him, by the number of His creation, by His pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the extent of His words.

evening.text: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ.
evening.transliteration: Astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh.
evening.translation: I seek the forgiveness of Allah and repent to Him.

general.text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ.
general.transliteration: Subhanallah, walhamdulillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar.
general.translation: Glory is to Allah, praise is to Allah, none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and Allah is the Most Great.

general.text: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ.
general.transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
general.translation: There is no might and no power except with Allah.

general.text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ.
general.translation: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him, Glory is to Allah the Great.

general.text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ.
general.transliteration: Allahumma salli wa sallim wa barik 'ala nabiyyina Muhammad.
general.translation: O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.

general.text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
general.transliteration: La ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul mulku wa lahul hamd...
general.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner...

general.text: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيَّ الْقَيُّومَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ.
general.translation: I ask forgiveness of Allah the Almighty, besides Whom there is no God, the Ever-Living...

general.text: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ.
general.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar.
general.translation: Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

general.text: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ.
general.transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmatan, innaka antal-Wahhab.
general.translation: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.

general.text: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ.
general.transliteration: Rabbij-'alni muqimas-salati wa min dhurriyyati, Rabbana wa taqabbal du'a.
general.translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.

general.text: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي ۞ وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي ۞ وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي ۞ يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي.
general.transliteration: Rabbish-rah li sadri, wa yassir li amri, wahlul 'uqdatan min lisani, yafqahu qawli.
general.translation: My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance] and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech.

general.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى.
general.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-huda wat-tuqa wal-'afafa wal-ghina.
general.translation: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and self-sufficiency.

general.text: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ.
general.translation: O Turner of the hearts, keep my heart firm upon Your religion.

general.text: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ.
general.transliteration: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatik.
general.translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, to give You thanks, and to perform Your worship in the best manner.

general.text: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ. اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ.
general.transliteration: Astaghfirullah (x3). Allahumma antas-salamu wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram.
general.translation: I ask Allah for forgiveness (three times). O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Owner of majesty and honor.

general.text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (33)، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (33)، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (33)، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
general.transliteration: Subhanallah (33), Alhamdulillah (33), Allahu Akbar (33), La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah...
general.translation: Glory is to Allah (33 times), praise is to Allah (33 times), Allah is the Most Great (33 times). None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone...
